name: Mom
source:
A caring, loving figure, filled to the brim with the insight and wisdom only a mother can possess. It's good to know that amidst all of the drama and stresses of teenage life, family will always be there for you. Should you listen to her advice, or has the time away from home made her too distant from her son?
